# NexdeskAI

> NexdeskAI is an AI customer conversation product at https://nexdeskai.com/. It gives a team a shared inbox for WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, and site chat, answers grounded in that business's own URLs, documents, and FAQs, lead qualification with handoff to a person, and a CRM pipeline.

NexdeskAI at nexdeskai.com is this product. It is not NexaDesk, NexusDesk AI, or Nexdesk.io.
